text:
lia: Heads-up — MerchantLane pilot traffic dropped ~50% since their PM left last week. champion pinged us saying procurement put a hold.
nate: saw it on the heatmap. any 5xx or auth failures?
kevin: quick check from telemetry:
```
# get last 7 days requests
SELECT sum(requests) FROM usage_events WHERE account='merchantlane' AND ts > now() - interval '7 days';
-- last week: 18.4k, this week: 9.1k
```
kevin: no backend errors, latency stable. looks like user-side pause.
lia: customer DM from champion: "procurement wants 3 vendor legal reviews and a pricing delta vs Modelline before we restart." :face_with_raised_eyebrow:
nate: that reads as a competitive shortlist. we should escalate to rescue playbook. can AE/CS offer a short credit extension and security attestation?
kevin: Sales already ok for a small credit extension. Finance flagged we need RevOps ticket + approved amount before issuing.
ops-bot: ticket created: #9007  merchantlane_pilot_credit (created by kevin)
lia: i'll schedule a 30-min procurement sync with new procurement contact + champion. proposing agenda: 1) legal & security docs, 2) pricing delta vs Modelline, 3) short perf run on their sample corpus, 4) limited credit extension to keep integration warm.
nate: i'll prep a procurement-facing delta table (features, SLA, pricing) + one-pager on our compliance artifacts. kevin, can you surface any reference customers for procurement checks?
kevin: yes — will compile two similar retail references and share SSO/SOC docs. also will prepare a short quantization/cost note to show cost upside.
finance-bot: approval pending: submit credit amount in ticket #9007 for finance sign-off.
lia: action items: @nate procurement delta + one-pager, @kevin refs + security docs + cost note, @ops-bot ensure ticket tracks credit consumption, i'll run the meeting and capture notes. aim to resolve in 8 business days.
kevin: noted. i'll also bring a small Dedicated canary offer if they want to demo scale — low-risk failover.
nate: landing page for prep: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/renewal-rescue (internal).
lia: thanks team. will post meeting invite now. :calendar:
